help.description: Inspect, convert and load LangChain FAISS stores without executing pickle.
help.epilog: Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 check failed (unsafe/unsupported/mismatch), 2 usage error, 3 damaged or unreadable input, 4 optional dependencies missing.
help.lang: Display language: en or ko (default: FAISS_DEFUSE_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG, else en).
help.scan: Statically scan index.pkl; nothing is executed.
help.inspect: Show index header, document count, mapping check and metadata keys.
help.convert: Write a pickle-free copy (index.faiss + docstore.jsonl + manifest.json).
help.verify: Check a pickle-free store, optionally against its original.
help.demo: Build offline sample stores and run the whole flow.
help.path: Store directory written by FAISS.save_local (or a pickle-free store, or an index.pkl file).
help.index_name: index_name used when the store was saved (default: index).
help.limit: Raise (or lower) one resource limit, for example --limit max_doc_nodes=500000. Repeatable. Names: {names}.
help.dst: Destination directory for the pickle-free store.
help.overwrite: Replace an existing pickle-free store in the destination.
help.distance_strategy: LangChain DistanceStrategy to record (default: inferred from the index metric).
help.normalize_l2: Record normalize_L2=True (not stored in the original pickle, so it cannot be inferred).
help.against: Original store directory to compare with (scanned, never executed).
help.trust_original: Also compare with LangChain's own load_local. This EXECUTES the original pickle; use only on stores you built.
help.probes: Number of stored vectors used as probe queries (default 20).
finding.dotted-name: attribute path in a global name
finding.unresolved-global: could not resolve the imported name
finding.persistent-id: persistent id would call application code
finding.extension-code: extension code resolves to an arbitrary global
finding.unsupported-value-type: harmless type that this version cannot convert (not a safety verdict)
finding.malformed-pickle: pickle is damaged, so it cannot be proven harmless
finding.trailing-data: extra bytes after the end of the pickle
inspect.mapping_ok: mapping       OK (ntotal matches the id map)
verify.ok_full: VERIFIED {docs}/{docs} docs, top-{k} equal for {probes} probe vectors
verify.ok_integrity: VERIFIED integrity only (hashes, header, mapping); pass --against to compare with the original
verify.trusted_note: (compared with LangChain load_local: this executed the original pickle)
demo.intro: Practice mode: real scans on real files, but the embeddings are fake and deterministic (search quality is meaningless).
demo.sentinel_ok: sentinel file: not created - nothing was executed
demo.sentinel_bad: sentinel file: CREATED - something executed the payload
error.unsupported: cannot convert store: unsupported value type ({names}). This is not a safety verdict; please open an issue with the type name.
error.manifest_mismatch: {file} does not match manifest.json (expected {expected}, got {actual}). The store was modified after it was written; rebuild it with `faiss-defuse convert`.
error.missing_extra_detail: {what} requires the optional dependencies. Install them with: pip install "faiss-defuse[langchain]"
error.exists.not-a-directory: {path} exists and is not a directory.
error.exists.holds-store: {path} already holds a store. Pass --overwrite to replace it.
error.exists.same-as-source: destination must differ from the source directory.
error.detail.missing-file: {path} cannot be read or does not exist. Check the path (use --index-name if you saved with a custom index_name).
error.detail.no-pickle: {path} is already a pickle-free store; there is no pickle to scan. Use `faiss-defuse inspect` or `verify` instead.
error.detail.limit-exceeded: a size limit was exceeded (Limits.{limit}). Raise it if this size is expected, or check the input.
error.limit_hint: To allow it from the command line, pass --limit {limit}=<number> (Python: Limits({limit}=...)).
error.limit_arg: invalid --limit value '{value}': use NAME=NUMBER with a whole number of at least 1. Names: {names}.
error.detail.reference-amplification: index.pkl reuses shared objects so often that decoding would copy more than {cap} items (twice the file size). Real LangChain stores never do this; the file looks crafted to exhaust memory.
error.detail.bad-faiss-header: index.faiss has an invalid or truncated header.
error.detail.unsupported-index-type: this FAISS index type is not supported.
error.detail.bad-tag: the document store holds an invalid typed value.
error.detail.bad-manifest: manifest.json is missing a field or is invalid.
error.detail.unsupported-format-version: manifest.json uses a format this version does not read. Upgrade faiss-defuse or rebuild the store.
error.detail.mapping-mismatch: the index and the document store do not match (ids, positions or counts).
error.detail.manifest-index-mismatch: index.faiss differs from what manifest.json records.
error.detail.unexpected-structure: index.pkl does not have the expected LangChain structure.
mapping.count: index_to_docstore_id has {entries} entries but the index holds {ntotal} vectors
mapping.no-id: {count} vector positions have no document id (first: {first})
mapping.outside: {count} mapped positions are outside the index (first: {first})
mapping.absent: {count} mapped document ids are missing from the docstore (first: {first})
warn.distance-strategy-unknown: index metric {metric} has no LangChain DistanceStrategy; pass --distance-strategy explicitly
warn.normalize-l2-unknown: normalize_L2 is not stored in the original pickle and cannot be inferred; assumed False. Pass --normalize-l2 if the store was built with it.
warn.distance-strategy-inferred: distance_strategy {strategy} inferred from the index metric ({metric})
verify.reason.topk-no-reconstruct: this index type cannot reconstruct stored vectors
